scope: Independent isolated-fixture follow-up of lifecycle review; no real user data or tracked source edits. Not full acceptance.
review_notes: Scoped middleware holds the shared barrier through complete await target ASGI responses, including FileResponse file consumption.
Tombstones are rechecked before cached child engines; deleted original routes fail without touching Store/Runtime.
Cleanup commits durable tombstones first, confines original managed filenames, preserves catalog and unrelated files, and defers cleanup while live readers exist.
Recovery uses only non-null active identity; deletion never promotes an uncertain archive.
